preconditions.description: The length of the sequence n is between 2 and 30000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**8 <= ai <= 10**8 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each element ai in the sequence a is between -10^8 and 10^8 inclusive.
The length of the sequence a is exactly n.
All elements in the sequence a are distinct.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No solution' or (len(progression1) >= 1 and len(progression2) >= 1 and sorted(progression1 + progression2) == sorted(a) and is_arithmetic(progression1) and is_arithmetic(progression2))
postconditions.description: The output is either 'No solution' or two arithmetic progressions that together contain all elements of the input sequence a without repetition.
